issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: iron_bars, red_wall_banner.
170 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
13 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.
No door on the front half (z = 0 is the front, toward the easel).
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Adds iron-bar windows, a red banner over the door and torches beside it; the side faces are still bare.
notes.life: Torches by the door count as light; still no plants.

visual.summary: L1 plus iron-bar windows, a red wall banner over the town-side door and door torches; visibly more finished than L1.
problems: Same narrow west walk entrance as L1: (0,5,2) and (0,6,2) are solid, so the walk is 1 wide where it enters from the west.
Reachability: fine - 50 of 51 reached; only (1,5,3) beside the stair is not.
